name: react-native-best-practices
headline: vscode-agent-skill-ninja: Manage AI Skills in VS
short_description: The vscode-agent-skill-ninja is a powerful VS Code extension designed for searching, installing, and managing Agent Skills for AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot and Claude Code. Enhance your coding experience with easy access to a variety of skills tailored for AI-driven development.
author: aktsmm

sections.overview:
Agent Skills Ninja is a VS Code extension that centralizes skill discovery and management for AI coding assistants. It enables you to search skills by keyword across local repositories and GitHub, install them into your workspace with a single click, and automatically sync them to instruction files like AGENTS.md or copilot-instructions.md. The extension supports multiple output formats (ref, full, compact, legacy) and manages skills across workspace, user/global, and extension scopes. It works with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Cline, helping teams standardize and share AI agent capabilities.
Search for specific Agent Skills quickly
Install new skills to enhance coding capabilities
Manage existing skills for better performance
Integrate AI coding assistants into development workflow
sections.usage:
```
Find and install the top 5 Agent Skills for [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE] development in VS Code. I want skills that help with [SPECIFIC_TASK] like code generation, debugging, or architecture design. Also, recommend any complementary extensions that work well with these skills.
```
